name: Pokehasp
description: Lay the flat against the opponent's blade and press to judge its strength before choosing to slip or push.

name: Sturdy Shortspine
description: Press the edge against the opponent's blade and hold the contact so the point cannot swing around.

name: Brisk Sting
description: Slide the point along the opponent's blade after a bind and thrust at the hand behind the guard.

name: Fleet Cutedge
description: Break from a bind with a quick step to the side and reset the blade before the opponent follows.

name: Clutching Hiltcap
description: Lock the opponent's blade in the crossguard and send qi through the pommel hand to hold it fixed in place.

name: Keen Gore
description: Slip the point out of a bind along the forearm and stab the unguarded shoulder with qi sharpening the tip.

name: Rooted Broadleaf
description: Set the shoulder to a wall and hold the blade angled outward so the opponent can approach from one side only.

name: Gorethwack
description: Keep the elbow pinned to the ribs and stab straight ahead in a space too tight to swing.

name: Slinking Knobgrip
description: Slide sideways between bodies and furniture with the point low so no step catches on an obstacle.

name: Ducking Shortspine
description: Duck beneath a low beam or lintel while stabbing upward at an opponent who expected a high guard.

name: Padded Handguard
description: Use the door frame to stop a swing and turn the opponent's blade aside against the wood.

name: Cramping Thumbrest
description: Drive the opponent against a wall with the shoulder and pin the sword arm with the flat and a pulse of qi.

name: Digflog
description: Burst forward in a short stab with qi from the legs when no room remains for a backswing.

name: Regimen Hiltcap
description: Hold the point on the centre line between the bodies so a longer blade cannot swing in without crossing it.

name: Honed Gore
description: Dip beneath a long blade's swing and prick the underarm where the armor opens as it rises.

name: Draught Poke
description: Step into the arc of a long cut before it gains force and meet it near the hilt.

name: Poise Stubblade
description: Meet a longer blade near its hilt where it is weakest and halt the swing with the crossguard.

name: Brawnstab
description: Strike the opponent's gripping hand with the pommel once inside reach to force the weapon loose.

name: Embernick
description: Stab along the line of the ribs under a raised guard arm while the body turns out of reach.

name: Static Sting
description: Push qi down the arm to surge along the inner line and land a stab before a longer blade can retract.

name: Discord Handguard
description: Hook the crossguard under the opponent's hilt and overturn the blade with a pulse of qi to break the grip.

name: Stubthwack
description: Perform the course's standard thrust with qi gathered at the wrist and released at the point.

name: Armored Cutedge
description: Fill the edge with qi to meet a heavy cut and turn it aside without the blade shuddering.

name: Lithe Dig
description: Shift weight onto the lead leg and glide into stabbing range in a single smooth motion.

name: Thumbscreen
description: Snap the blade back across the body after a stab to cover the opening the thrust created.

name: Nickswat
description: Flick the point backhand across the opponent's guard to stab the open cheek or shoulder.

name: Attentive Broadleaf
description: Tap the opponent's blade twice and read the qi hum in the steel to judge his strength and intent.

name: Pokeslap
description: Drive a hard qi pulse down the blade as the point lands to push through cloth and leather.

name: Layered Pointcap
description: Let qi flow back into the guard arm as the thrust ends so the blade covers the body before a counter lands.

name: Twofold Stab
description: Chain a stab and a half step and a second stab so each motion carries qi into the next.

name: Buttressed Stubblade
description: Stand at the mouth of a corridor with the blade held forward so only one foe may advance at a time.

name: Scudding Cutedge
description: Step across a doorway to block a fleeing opponent and hold the point at his chest.

name: Tipslap
description: Thrust downward from the top of a stair at an opponent climbing with the sword arm low.

name: Resolute Knobgrip
description: Turn aside a downward cut from a higher step by lifting the blade across the incoming edge.

name: Alert Shortspine
description: Slide the blade tip around a corner and read the faint tap of contact to locate a waiting foe.

name: Coasting Broadleaf
description: Slide through a narrow gap sideways with the blade tucked flat against the chest.

name: Stalwart Thumbrest
description: Let a cut glance off the wall and ride the rebound to counter-stab the exposed arm.

name: Stalling Stabtip
description: Hold a doorway with a steady qi-backed point so that foes hesitate to push through and lose their pace.

name: Goreslap
description: Drop from a stair or ledge and plunge the point down into the opponent below with qi in the arms.

name: Stingswat
description: Swing round a corner post on the lead foot and drive a qi-backed thrust into the waiting foe.

name: Steady Cutedge
description: Hold the blade across a partner's open side to cover the flank while he attacks.

name: Crimson Nick
description: Stab at the flank of an opponent who is fixed on a partner's blade across the front.

name: Rillpoke
description: Swap places with a partner by a shoulder pass so a fresh blade meets the opponent.

name: Brass Sting
description: Strike in time with a partner's cut so the opponent can only parry one of two blades.

name: Haze Broadleaf
description: Stand back to back with a partner and turn aside blows that fall on either side.

name: Nickflog
description: Answer a partner's signal by stabbing through the gap his feint has just opened in the opponent's guard.

name: Purpose Thumbrest
description: Match qi rhythm with a partner so that both blades answer each strike with a steadier edge.

name: Splice Cutedge
description: Pin the opponent's blade between two short swords crossed from different angles and hold it with qi.

name: Brisk Stubblade
description: Settle the forward grip with the thumb along the spine and thrust with the blade in line with the forearm.

name: Dense Hiltcap
description: Turn the blade point-down along the forearm so the edge covers the arm and the elbow strikes close.

name: Thumbswerve
description: Toss the blade a short way to the other hand while stepping off the line of a cut.

name: Stabthwack
description: Lay the thumb on the pommel and drive a heavy point-first stab through a narrow gap.

name: Raw Cutedge
description: Turn the edge upward in reverse grip and rip it across the belly of a charging opponent.

name: Swift Pointcap
description: Pivot the blade between grips with qi steady in the wrist so the stab changes angle without a pause.

name: Entangling Handguard
description: Pass the sword behind the back to the other hand so the opponent loses sight of the point's line.

name: Rigid Shortspine
description: Slip the blade along a spear shaft and turn the head aside before stepping into its reach.

name: Prowling Cutedge
description: Step past the spearhead on the open side with the blade covering the line of the shaft.

name: Stubflog
description: Cut the leading hand on a long shaft as it comes into range and force the weapon to drop.

name: Burdening Stabtip
description: Crowd a long sword with the body so the blade cannot be drawn back for a second cut.

name: Tipcurl
description: Dip below a sweeping cut and drive forward into the opponent's belly with the point leading.

name: Stubhasp
description: Hook the crossguard over a polearm haft and pull to drag the opponent off balance.

name: Springing Pointcap
description: Burst through the dead ground in front of a long weapon with qi in the legs to arrive inside its guard.

name: Tethering Knobgrip
description: Smother the long weapon's swing with blade and shoulder and keep qi on the point so the foe cannot back away.

name: Vicious Gore
description: Drive a qi-driven stab into the gap beneath the opponent's chin or arm once past his weapon's reach.

name: Clay Pointcap
description: Hold the shield high with the blade ready low behind its edge so the body shows little target.

name: Honed Dig
description: Stab out past the shield rim at the leg or hand before drawing the point back behind cover.

name: Gall Hiltcap
description: Punch the shield boss into the opponent's chest to stagger him and open a clear stab.

name: Crimson Dig
description: Slash low beneath the shield's lower edge at an opponent's ankle while the upper body stays covered.

name: Gritnick
description: Advance a short pace behind the shield rim keeping the blade tucked and the feet close to the ground.

name: Rill Stubblade
description: Catch a heavy cut on the rim and roll it down along the face of the shield.

name: Sprig Stabtip
description: Hook the opponent's blade with the shield rim and stab beneath it with the short sword.

name: Sleet Knobgrip
description: Brace behind the shield and push qi into it so a charge breaks against a steady unyielding face.

name: Ember Sting
description: Rush behind the shield and release a qi-driven stab around its edge the moment contact is made.

name: Static Thumbrest
description: Flick the shield rim against the opponent's wrist with qi behind it to snap the weapon from his hand.

name: Stabslap
description: Land the lead foot and the point on the same beat so body weight travels into the stab.

name: Digzip
description: Lift the rear heel and extend the lead leg to gain a handspan of reach on the stab.

name: Rough Pointcap
description: Slip on the diagonal away from a cut and stab the opponent's side as the blade passes.

name: Guarding Broadleaf
description: Press the lead foot into the ground and hold the blade steady while the opponent tests the guard.

name: Stubborn Cutedge
description: Retire one pace while turning the blade across the line of a cut to bat it harmlessly aside.

name: Pokeswat
description: Prick the opponent's forearm and pull back in one beat before any answering cut can be started.

name: Fleet Gore
description: Drive qi into the thighs for a long low lunge that ends with the point striking the target.

name: Woven Poke
description: Chain a step and a stab and a recovery into a single motion with qi carried through all three.
